## One Note. Precise Edits.

Give Author Agent a direction: "make her voice colder" or "shift chapter 3 to her point of view." It reads the entire novel and rewrites exactly what you mean.

I want Elara's opening scene more intimate. Let the reader feel what she feels. Closer, quieter, more visceral. |

I've rewritten three passages in Chapter 1 to bring the reader closer to Elara's internal experience. The changes shift from observational distance to sensory immersion.

She stood at the window, watching the empty street below.

She pressed her palm flat against the glass. Her breath fogged it in short, ragged bursts.

The house was quiet except for the clock on the mantle, its ticking steady and indifferent.

"They'll be here soon," she told herself.

"They'll be here soon." The words came out smaller than she intended.

### Give the note

Agent reads the whole novel and edits precisely.

### Review every change

Tracked diffs. Nothing saves without your approval.

### Undo anything

Full rollback in one click. No risk.
